name: Kenya-Ultra
description: Kenya-Ultra WhatsApp bot client — pairs with a Core-issued SESSION_ID and connects to WhatsApp via Baileys.

SESSION_ID.description: Your Kenya-Ultra session ID, generated by pairing through Core. Paste the full KenyaUltra~... string exactly as given.

CHANNEL_LINK.description: Optional override for the WhatsApp channel the bot auto-follows on connect. Leave unset to use the built-in Kenya-Ultra channel.

GROUP_INVITE_LINK.description: Optional override for the WhatsApp group the bot auto-joins on connect. Leave unset to use the built-in Kenya-Ultra support group.
